lines.toggle.desk1.open_reveal: The drawer resists, then gives. Inside, an iron key.
lines.toggle.desk1.open: The drawer slides out along its runners, easy with long use.
lines.toggle.desk1.closed: You press the drawer home, and it seats with a soft knock of oak on oak.
lines.toggle.door1.open: The iron ring turns, the latch lifts, and the plank door swings wide.
lines.toggle.door1.closed: The door falls to, and the latch drops into its keeper.
lines.toggle.desk1.refused_unreachable: The desk is beyond your reach from where you stand.
lines.toggle.door1.refused_unreachable: The door will not answer from here; you must come before it.
lines.toggle.chair1.refused_static: The chair is joined oak through and through; nothing in it opens or shuts.
lines.toggle.stick1.refused_static: The candlestick is a single casting of brass; there is nothing in it to work.
lines.toggle.shelf1.refused_static: The shelf is fixed boards, pegged fast; it keeps no hinge and no drawer.
lines.toggle.note1.refused_static: The notebook has neither clasp nor lock; its leaves simply lie as they lie.
lines.toggle.coin1.refused_static: The coin is one small disc of silver; it neither opens nor closes.
lines.toggle.key1.refused_static: The key holds no working of its own; it is made for a lock, not to be one.
lines.take.key1.taken: You take the iron key. It is cold, and lighter than it looks.
lines.take.note1.taken: You lift the vellum notebook, and its leaves whisper as they settle.
lines.take.coin1.taken: The silver coin comes away from the shelf board with a faint scrape.
lines.take.key1.refused_held: The iron key is already in your keeping.
lines.take.note1.refused_held: The notebook is with you already, safe among what you carry.
lines.take.coin1.refused_held: The coin already rides with you; your fingers know its edge.
lines.take.key1.refused_unreachable: The key is not within reach of your hand from here.
lines.take.note1.refused_unreachable: The notebook lies too far off; you are not near enough to take it.
lines.take.coin1.refused_unreachable: The coin is out of your reach; your arm does not stretch so far.
lines.take.key1.refused_contained: The drawer is shut over the key; it must be opened again first.
lines.take.desk1.refused_fixed: The desk is heavy joined oak, pegged at every corner; it will not be carried.
lines.take.chair1.refused_fixed: The wainscot chair is a solid burden of oak; it keeps its place.
lines.take.door1.refused_fixed: The door hangs on its iron hinges, and there it will hang.
lines.take.stick1.refused_fixed: The brass candlestick is a great floor-piece, heavier than it has any right to be; it stays where it was set.
lines.take.shelf1.refused_fixed: The bookshelf is a full press of oak against the wall; no strength of yours will shift it.
lines.go.door_study_hall.arrive: You step through into the hall, on into wider air, and cooler.
lines.go.door_hall_study.arrive: You pass back into the study, where ink and oak dust close about you again.
lines.go.door_study_hall.refused_closed: The door is shut against you; the latch has not been lifted.
lines.go.door_hall_study.refused_closed: The way back stands barred; the door wants opening first.
lines.go.door_study_hall.refused_unreachable: The way to the hall does not open from where you stand.
lines.go.door_hall_study.refused_unreachable: The way to the study is not before you; you must come to it first.
lines.toggle.*.refused_unknown: Nothing of that description offers itself to your hand.
lines.take.*.refused_unknown: You reach, and your hand closes on nothing of the sort.
lines.go.*.refused_unknown: No such passage is to be found; the walls keep their counsel.
lines.turn.*.refused: The room offers no other aspect; you face all there is to face.
